## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`, investigation Step 3): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

Both records complete, T_sample 1.17–1.29 K throughout, sr1 at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS) never above 12 % of range, no gate-current excess beyond the flyback transient. Raw first, then the MR-subtracted 1/B record, then per-tone onsets (`sdh_onset`) and a 1/B-FFT stability sweep over window / detrender, with F_L and the forward model's tones (`fs_count_b0`, u_D = 0) overlaid.

**Run 6 (electron, F_L = 33.1 T) — a two-tone record.** (i) **f₁ ≈ 7.0 T** (SNR 40; FFT 6.7–7.0 T across windows): oscillations with this period are visible in the record down to its 1 T sampled edge — run 6 is 50 mT-stepped below 1 T (under Nyquist for a 7 T tone there), so `sdh_onset` reports it *censored*: its onset is **≤ 1 T, not pinned**. (ii) **f₂ ≈ 30–32 T** (dominant; onset 1.9 T; 29.9 T in the B > 1.5/2.5 windows, 32.2 T in B > 3.5 — a 2 T wander with window, i.e. δF-limited at this record length) with its 2× at 60 T and 3× at 86 T in the high-B window (non-sinusoidal deep minima above 4 T). The 14 and 22 T features sit at 2×/3× f₁ (harmonic-screen candidates, or f₂ − f₁ / f₂ − 2f₁ intermodulation) — the fan's n-dependence decides. **Against the templates:** the model's ABAB pair at +3.2×10¹² is 7.3 / 25.8 T — the light tone matches f₁ to 4 %; the heavy tone sits 16 % above 25.8 T. f₁ + f₂ = 37–39 T vs F_L = 33.1 T → a global density scale of 1.12–1.18 (inside the 0.8–1.2 lever-arm prior, at its edge; c_tg is a 9.5 nm geometry prior). Alternative readings the fan must discriminate: f₂ as an ABCA-like singleton at 0.91–0.97·F_L (then f₁ is an unexplained second Fermi surface — ABCA has one), f₂ as the 4× harmonic of f₁ (28.4 T; disfavoured — f₂ is 3–4 T off and the strongest peak), or a region-B mosaic contribution (ridge B is 13 % more electron-doped: its heavy tone at ×1.13 would blend into f₂ at this δF). **Preliminary: two-tone at +3.2×10¹², consistent-with the ABAB pair; not a call** — the scale fork (1.15 with the sum, 0.93 with a singleton) is exactly what F(n) across density pins.

**Run 7 (hole, F_L = 12.4 T) — the predicted near-CNP regime, uninformative for the call.** Clean SdH from **0.7 T** (lower onset than the electron side — quantum mobility is fine on both signs), but the tone set (4.7, 6.6, 8.5, 9.4, 12.3 T; the dominant peak moves from 5.3 T to 10 T with the window) is the close, balanced, beat-like pair the recipe names as the low-|n| exception (model ABAB 5.9 / 6.5 T; ABCA 12.4 T with m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ, LK-dead at T_e ≈ 8 K). The hole side is TG-limited to |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² on the D = 0 line, so it cannot reach the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² window where the templates separate.

**Handed to Step 4 (fan):** electron side; f₁ onset ≤ 1 T (fan B_lo below 1 T), heavy-tone onset 1.9 T; fastest content to Nyquist ≈ 60 T (2× f₂); settling 10 τ at every field point was the spot-check floor; the fan reads its per-column FFT at n = 3.2 against this record (same density, finer B grid — the grid-change reproduction of Verify).

"""Runs 6 + 7 — sdh-spot-check read (investigation Step 3): raw R(B) first, then bg-subtracted 1/B records,
per-tone onsets (hera.analysis.sdh_onset) and 1/B FFTs (sdh_fft) against F_L and the model's ABAB / ABCA tones."""
import sys
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, sdh_fft, SdhOnsetError, luttinger_frequency

# model tones at the two spot densities (hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count/fs_count_b0.py, u_D = 0):
MODEL = {6: dict(n=+3.2, abab=(7.3, 25.8), abca=33.1, m_abab=(0.027, 0.061), m_abca=0.074),
         7: dict(n=-1.2, abab=(5.9, 6.5), abca=12.4, m_abab=(0.074, 0.032), m_abca=1.12)}
SENS, I_BIAS = 50e-6, 10e-9
WINDOWS = [(1.5, 5), (2.5, 5), (3.5, 5), (2.5, 3)]   # (B_lo cutoff, bg_degree) — FFT stability sweep

fig, axs = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
spot = {}
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = run(rid); print(summarize_run(r))
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = (r.col("sr1_X") / 1.0) / (r.col("sr0_X") / -1e6)   # R = (V/gain_V)/(I_X/gain_I), device card
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    T = r.col("T_sample"); n12 = MODEL[rid]["n"]; FL = luttinger_frequency(n12 * 1e16)
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n12:+.1f}e12, B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T ({len(B)} pts), R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm "
          f"(max {R.max()/(SENS/I_BIAS)*100:.0f} % of the 5 kOhm FS), T_sample {T.min():.3f}-{T.max():.3f} K, F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
    # (0) raw
    axs[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.6, color="k"); axs[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid} — raw Rxx(B), n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0"); axs[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); axs[0, j].set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)")
    # (1) onset, per tone
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=SENS / I_BIAS); print(on.summary()); spot[rid] = on
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"run {rid}: SdhOnsetError — {e}")
    # (2) bg-subtracted record vs 1/B (deg-5 in B, B > 1 T)
    m = B > 1.0; dR = R[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[m], R[m], 5), B[m])
    axs[1, j].plot(1 / B[m], dR, lw=0.6); axs[1, j].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); axs[1, j].set_ylabel("dRxx (Ohm)"); axs[1, j].set_title("MR background removed (deg 5 in B, B > 1 T) vs 1/B")
    # (3) FFT stability sweep
    for (lo, deg), c in zip(WINDOWS, ("C0", "C1", "C2", "C3")):
        f, S = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, B.max()), bg_degree=deg); s = S[0] / S[0].max()
        pk, _ = find_peaks(s, prominence=0.05); pk = sorted(pk, key=lambda k: -s[k])[:6]
        print(f"  FFT window B > {lo} T, bg deg {deg}: peaks " + ", ".join(f"{f[k]:.1f} T ({s[k]:.2f})" for k in pk))
        axs[2, j].plot(f, s, c, lw=0.9, label=f"B > {lo} T, deg {deg}")
    md = MODEL[rid]
    axs[2, j].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
    for F in md["abab"]: axs[2, j].axvline(F, color="tab:red", ls=":", lw=1)
    axs[2, j].axvline(md["abca"], color="tab:green", ls="-.", lw=1)
    axs[2, j].plot([], [], "tab:red", ls=":", label=f"model ABAB {md['abab'][0]} / {md['abab'][1]} T"); axs[2, j].plot([], [], "tab:green", ls="-.", label=f"model ABCA {md['abca']} T")
    axs[2, j].set_xlim(0, 2.1 * FL); axs[2, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); axs[2, j].set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm.)"); axs[2, j].legend(fontsize=7); axs[2, j].set_title("1/B FFT — stability sweep vs window / detrender")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`), D = 0, n = +1.0 → +3.2×10¹², B 0.75 → 10 T uniform in 1/B

> **05:29** · landau-fan-vti e-side: D=0, n=+1.0..+3.2e12 (67-pt paired n-line, fast), B 0.75->10 T uniform 1/B (166 rows, slow), sr1 100 uV, fast\_delay 1.2 s / slow\_delay 3 s; ends at 10 T, gates at n=+3.2 · **ETA ~11:39** (≈6h10m)

**Why this fan.** The spot checks (ana: runs 6 + 7) hand Step 4 the electron side: run 6 at n = +3.2×10¹² is a clean two-tone record — f₁ ≈ 7.0 T (alive to the record's 1 T sampled edge; onset *not* pinned, the 50 mT leg below 1 T under-samples it) and a dominant f₂ ≈ 30–32 T (onset 1.9 T, 2× at 60 T) — with the light tone on the model's ABAB partner (7.3 T) but the heavy tone 16 % above the model's 25.8 T, so the record forks between "ABAB pair at density scale ≈ 1.15" and "ABCA-like singleton at scale ≈ 0.93 plus an unexplained 7 T pocket"; f₂ = 4×f₁ (28.4 T) and a region-B mosaic blend (+13 % n) are the confounds. Only F(n) across density separates these: a harmonic tracks 4·f₁(n) exactly, an ABAB pair tracks the model's two curves with one global scale and sums to F_L(n), a singleton tracks F_L alone, a mosaic partner tracks ×1.13. The hole side (run 7, −1.2×10¹²) is the near-CNP exception regime and is TG-limited to |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² — it cannot reach where the templates separate; **excluded from the fan, stated.** n < 1.0×10¹² is also excluded (templates merge there; 2.6 min per column).

**Design (Step 2, computed).** Model table (`fs_count_b0`, u_D = 0): ABAB pair 0.6/9.8 T at +1.0, 3.6/17.1 at +2.0, 7.3/25.8 at +3.2×10¹²; ABCA = F_L (10.3 / 20.7 / 33.1 T). **Field axis:** the fastest content to protect is 2×f₂ = 60 T → Δ(1/B) = 0.0075 /T (Nyquist 67 T; the 1/3 rule holds to 44 T, i.e. through the F_L band at scale 1.2) → **166 rows, 0.75 → 10 T**. B_lo = 0.75 T: below run 6's censored 1 T edge; gives the ABAB partner ≥ 5 periods for f ≥ 4.1 T (n ≥ 2.2×10¹²; 4.4 periods at n = 2.0), and puts the ν = 8 / 12 / 16 rays at n = 3.2 (1.65 / 1.10 / 0.83 T) inside the window — the layer-number ladder (Step 6, weak). Tone resolution δF = 1/(1/1.9 − 1/10) = 2.4 T for the heavy tone (onset 1.9 T) — ABAB-heavy 25.8 vs ABCA 33.1 is a 3·δF split; 0.81 T for tones alive from 0.75 T. **n axis:** 67 pts, Δn = 0.033×10¹² → 2.2 pts per LL-ray spacing at 0.75 T, 2.9 at 1 T (≥ 2 floor). n_hi = 3.2 = run 6's density (the shared-density column for the acquisition-quality and grid-change comparison). **Sensitivity** fixed at 100 µV = 10 kΩ FS: worst corner is n = 1.0 × 10 T (ν ≈ 4) — R(0) = 117 Ω (run 5), and run 7 at |n| = 1.2 / ν ≈ 5 peaked at 587 Ω at 10 T → > 10× headroom; digitization 0.37 Ω/LSB (run 5 measured) against ≥ 5 Ω SdH amplitude at 1 T (run 6). **Dwell:** fast_delay 1.2 s = 4τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB; the per-column FFT runs along B, so the fast-axis lag is a uniform column shift of ~0.4 Δn, not a distortion), slow_delay 3 s = 10τ after each row's flyback, plus the driver's 3 s field settle. Region-B mosaic caveat: extra tones at ×1.13 of region A's, tracking the same curves.

**Direction and price.** Magnet is at 0 T: the fan ascends and **ends at 10 T with the gates at n = +3.2** — the next step (LK mass split / ride-down) starts there, no re-traverse. 11,122 pts × 1.37 s/pt (run 5: 1.17 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0 → 0.17 s reads) = 4.2 h + 166 rows × ~7 s (3 s settle per run 6 + flyback + slow_delay) = 19 min + 10 T bare traverse 73 min = 5.8 h; +7 % over → **≈ 6.2 h**. Row clock (uniform 1/B is dense at low B): row 45 = 1 T at +1.4 h, row 112 = 2 T at +3.4 h, row 134 = 3 T at +4.2 h. **Checkpoints:** first rows (~10 min; rows 0–2 at 0.75 T: signal, sensitivity, leakage beyond the flyback transient, gates tracking the n-line, T_sample); +1.4 h (B = 1 T: ν = 8/12/16 rays at high n, rails, T); +3.4 h (B = 2 T: partial per-column FFT — the light tone has ≥ 5 periods at n ≥ 2.5); completion → per-column FFT, Luttinger sum, F(n) overlay on the ABAB / ABCA (and trilayer) curves in ana. Abort on a leak trip, T_sample > 1.5 K sustained, or sr1 railing anywhere in n ≥ 2 (a low-n corner rail costs only those columns). E1 auto bucket: inside the validators, the 10 T cap, T untouched.

# === Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`): D = 0, n = +1.0 -> +3.2e12 paired n-line (fast, 67 pts) x B 0.75 -> 10 T uniform in 1/B (slow, 166 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = 9.5 nm geometry prior) — same CAL as runs 6/7 ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
D0 = 0.0                                          # V/nm
n_lo, n_hi, N_n = 1.0, 3.2, 67                    # 1e12 cm^-2; n_hi = run-6 spot density (shared-density column); 3.27 is the TG limit
ns = np.linspace(n_lo, n_hi, N_n)                 # ascending each row: low n -> high n
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, np.full(N_n, D0), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs, float), np.asarray(Vbgs, float)
_tg_ok, _bg_ok = sanitize_tg_bg(Vtgs, Vbgs, tg_lims, bg_lims)
assert len(_tg_ok) == N_n, f"n-line leaves the validators: {N_n - len(_tg_ok)} pts outside"
_n_chk, _D_chk = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
print(f"n-line: n = {n_lo:+.2f} .. {n_hi:+.2f}e12 ({N_n} pts, dn = {ns[1]-ns[0]:.4f}e12) at D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm -> "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f} .. {Vtgs.max():+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f} .. {Vbgs.max():+.4f} V; roundtrip |D| max {np.abs(np.asarray(_D_chk)).max():.1e}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vaporizer = {T_vaporizer():.3f} K, B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan ascends from 0.75 T), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"

# --- slow field axis: uniform in 1/B (per-column SdH FFT), d(1/B) = 0.0075 /T -> Nyquist 67 T (>= 2x the 60 T 2nd harmonic seen in run 6)
B_lo, B_hi, N_B = 0.75, 10.0, 166
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1.0 / B_lo, 1.0 / B_hi, N_B)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.2, 3.0                 # 4 tau at tau = 0.3 s / 24 dB (per-column FFT runs along B: the n-lag is a uniform column shift); 10 tau after each row flyback
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Worst corner is low n x high B (n = 1.0, 10 T, nu ~ 4):
# anchors R(0) = 117 Ohm (run 5) x MR/QH factor; run 7 (|n| = 1.2, nu ~ 5 at 10 T) peaked at 587 Ohm -> 10 kOhm is > 10x headroom.
# Digitization at 100 uV: 0.37 Ohm/LSB (run 5 measured step) vs >= 5 Ohm SdH amplitude at 1 T (run 6) — resolved.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"B grid: {N_B} rows, {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.2f} T, d(1/B) = {abs(np.diff(1/B_vec)).mean():.5f} /T (first dB {B_vec[1]-B_vec[0]:.4f}, last dB {B_vec[-1]-B_vec[-2]:.3f} T); "
      f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB, settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s; "
      f"{N_B * N_n} pts, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron side: D = {D0:+.2f} V/nm, n = {n_lo:+.2f} .. {n_hi:+.2f}e12 ({N_n} pts) fast, "
                  f"B {B_lo} -> {B_hi} T uniform 1/B ({N_B} rows) slow; run-5 cal; sr1 100 uV; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY}, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY}")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
